links.outcome: Telecarer-reported barriers to adopting the chatbot, including workflow burden from lack of EMR integration
links.effect: Lack of electronic medical record integration created administrative burden for telecarers and was a key barrier to adoption. Telecarer endorsement of universal rollout was cautious (3/7, 43%).
links.quote: Key barriers to adoption included administrative burden for telecarers due to a lack of electronic medical record integration and content redundancy for patients.

unlisted_practices: Co-design of a protocol-guided chatbot with clinicians, telecarers, and developers
Adaptive educational content tailored to patients' disease-specific literacy

screen.reason: Empirical mixed-methods evaluation of the feasibility and usability of a clinical protocol-guided chatbot deployed to support patients and telecarers in a hospital tele-support diabetes management program.
